info.name: Electro Store - user-service (Full Coverage)
info.description:
Kiem thu day du user-service (:8083).

## API coverage
- **Profile:** GET/PUT /api/users/me, PUT /api/users/change-password, GET /api/users/search
- **Wishlist:** GET/POST/DELETE /api/wishlist, check, clear, by id/product
- **Addresses:** CRUD + set default
- **Internal:** login, register, google-login, get user/address (Feign)
- **Gateway:** routes + block /api/internal/**

## Can chay
- user-service :8083, auth-service :8081, Redis, MySQL
- catalog-service :8082 (wishlist POST)
- api-gateway :8080 (folder 09)

## Import
user-service.postman_environment.json

## Thu tu
00 → 01 (login) → 02-10

Tao lai: python api-tests/generate_user_collection.py
Huong dan: api-tests/USER_POSTMAN_GUIDE.md
